flows.title: Share a site's stats with a link
steps: Open the website's settings, go to the Visibility area and find the Shared links section.
Click Add shared link. A window opens with the link's options.
Give the link a name for your own reference. Optionally limit it to a site segment, so viewers always see data filtered by that segment.
People with the link can view that one dashboard without a Plausible account. Later, the pencil icon next to the link edits it and the trash can icon removes it.

flows.title: Invite a team member
steps: In the top right menu, click your account name, check that the team you want is chosen, and click Team Settings.
Under the General option, invite the new member by email address and give them a role: Owner, Admin, Editor, Billing or Viewer.
Plausible emails them the invitation. They accept it with an account under that address, and invitations expire after 48 hours.

flows.title: Import stats from Google Analytics
steps: Open the site settings of the website to import into.
In the Imports & Exports section, find the Import Data panel and click the Google Analytics button to link your Google account.
From the drop-down menu, select the Google Analytics property to import and click Continue.
Click Confirm import. Plausible sends an email when the import is done, and the imported data then shows on the dashboard beside the native data.
